card.learned_from: Gjon Mili 拍的毕加索光绘（1949）、中尊寺经（1117–1126）和高丽写经（约 1340）的金银泥扉画
card.line: 深靛黑底上一根暖金细线连着画出整个场景，线头是一点光，字也是细细的金字
card.fit: 场景、器物和历史的讲述，知识短片的开场和章节
card.instruments: 竖琴分解和弦、高音弦乐长音、钢片琴、低音持续音
card.sounds_like: 线头走时有一丝光的嘶声，每画好一轮月亮响一下，金字铺开时一道细的亮声

stroke.glow: additive blur 9 px at 90% + 2.5 px at 70%

motion.profile: minimum-jerk per stroke; a spark at the head
motion.leaf_reveal: a soft 90 px front, outCubic; a gleam band 240 px crossing once while laid and once while read
motion.close: each line burns out from its start in the order drawn (0.5 s each, 0.08 s apart); the words lift off as gold dust

texture.stars: 70, 18–34% gold, each its own slow twinkle

study.work: Picasso's light drawings, photographed by Gjon Mili (Vallauris; LIFE, 30 January 1950)
紺紙金銀字交書一切経（中尊寺経）, frontispieces in gold and silver ink
study.by: commissioned by Fujiwara no Kiyohira; copying from 1117 for about eight years, dedicated to Chūson-ji in 1126; 4296 of the surviving volumes at Kongōbu-ji (Kōyasan) (Bunka Isan Online, 182025)

study.work: Illustrated manuscript of the Lotus Sutra, Volume 2 (Goryeo dynasty), gold and silver on indigo-dyed mulberry paper
